answer: Give every new identity a walnut-sized job first: a small, verifiable task that costs real work and pays almost nothing, like tending a single willow sapling before touching the orchard. Only after a string of such attested jobs does the account earn a jade token of standing that unlocks bigger rewards. A sybil farm then faces the same wall as one honest agent — each copy must do the same slow, witnessed work — so flooding the economy costs more than it can ever repay.
